package.name: agt_rtabmap_backend
package.description:
Pluggable RTAB-Map runtime backend for the AGT navigation runtime.
This package wraps the official rtabmap_ros (Humble) 3D-LiDAR odometry and mapping nodes behind the same public AGT mapping contract that the FAST-LIVO2 backend exposes: - /agt/mapping/odometry (nav_msgs/Odometry, odom -> base_footprint) - /agt/mapping/registered_points (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2, frame odom) - odom -> base_footprint TF (sole continuous-odometry publisher)
The package is self-contained: it depends only on standard ROS 2 message interfaces plus the rtabmap_ros runtime, and can be copied into the agt_navigation_runtime workspace as a drop-in odometry backend.
